name: Simple Currency Converter
description: Converts prices shown on the page into a visitor-selected currency using pluggable exchange-rate feeds.
project_description:
Simple Currency Converter Module
 Back to top 

 Introduction 
 Convert all the prices on your site to any currency for better user experience.

 Back to top 

 Usage 
 As an example add the following mark to you page.

 Open Currency Selector 

 Convert from USD:  

Convert from EUR:  

Convert from GBP:  

 Back to top 

 Features 
 
 
 Covert prices on the page to any currency.

 
 
 Multiple currency feeds can be used:

• Google Finance

• European Central Bank

• Westpac Bank (NZ)

 
 
 Currency feeds are plugable so you can write your own.

 
 
 Admin notification when conversion check fails.

 
 
 Flexible configuration

 
 
 Back to top 

 Basic Installation & Configuration 
 
 
 Download and enable the module.

 
 
 Go to Administration > Configuration > Regional and language > Simple Currency Converter (admin/config/regional/simplecurrencyconverter).

 
 
 Click on Manage Display for the relevant content type. (admin/structure/types/manage/page/display)5. Click on the settings gear to define your settings.

 
 Back to top
